title: No route writes an `advisory` log entry, and `nvs pkg audit` does not report one.
text: The log takes an `advisory` entry with its `versions` range, and the feed lists it, but an owner cannot send one and audit does not report a locked version inside its range. Closing it writes a route that takes an advisory from a token and waits seven days or from a passkey and takes effect at once, and `nvs pkg audit` reporting it (`rule:packaging/a-known-bad-version-is-retracted-not-deleted`).
